newsitem.title: UK: Venezuela reforms call for rating upgrade - Cen bank.
newsitem.headline: Venezuela reforms call for rating upgrade - Cen bank.

text.p: The success to date of tough IMF reforms in Venezuela mean the country should be considered for a rating review by Standard and Poor's and Moody's, Venezuela's central bank director said on Tuesday.
"All this calls for an upward review of the (debt) rating," Carlos Hernandez Delfino told Reuters in an interview in London.
"We are going to see Moody's and Standard and Poor's in Washington," he added.
Venezuela has a long term foreign currency debt rating of B from S&P's, and BA2 from Moody's. --Caroline Brothers, London Newsroom +44 171 542 2734
